Empanadas
Deep fried authentic home made empanada filled with fresh tomato sauce, mozzarella, oregano, and fresh basil.
Gambas Al Ajillo
Juicy king prawns with white wine, garlic, parsley, and touch of chilly.
Albondigas
Spanish style meatballs mixed with rice in a delicious italian tomato and garlic sauce.
Calamares
Crispy flavourful squid, fried with flour served with chive's aioli.
Gamberoni Mare e Monti
King prawn skewers wrapped with chorizo served with a fresh red cabbage and orange salad.
Pollo Wild Forest
Chicken breast with onions, mushroom, truffle sauce, cream, and an hint of cheese.
Frittura Di Pesce Alla Giuntoli Platter
Deep fried floured cod, squid, king prawns, battered soft shell baby crab, and mussels in garlic white wine and parsley sauces.
Spanish Pisto
Ratatouille of vegetables, tomato sauce, and herbs served with rice
Mix of Italian and Spanish Flavours
Recommended for 2. Cured meats selection, olives, croutons, cheese, and chef's surprise.

Also on the menu: pizze, pasta, paellas and risotto, a tapas menu, a kids menu and desserts. Ask us for today's full menu and prices.
